actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 415 - 0, 1 Present (Roll no. 225).
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 415 - 0, 1 Present (Roll no. 225).
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H4226-4227)

At the conclusion of debate, the chair put the question on the motion to suspend the rules. Mr. Williams (TX) objected to the vote on the grounds that a quorum was not present. Further proceedings on the motion were postponed. The point of no quorum was considered as withdrawn.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 7401.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H4140-4141; text: CR H4140)
Mr. Williams (TX) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 426.
Reported by the Committee on Small Business. H. Rept. 119-500.
Reported by the Committee on Small Business. H. Rept. 119-500.
Ordered to be Reported by the Yeas and Nays: 24 - 0.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Small Business.

dimensions.assessment: Applies directly to employees of the Small Business Administration who participate in loan processing and administration.
dimensions.evidence: an employee of the Administration that will personally and substantially participate in the origination, review, or approval of a loan

dimensions.assessment: Administrative requirement for employees to certify compliance with existing conflict-of-interest laws rather than altering loan terms or business operations.
dimensions.evidence: certify to the Administrator in writing that such employee... does not have any conflict of interest

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply any direct federal spending allocations or economic impact figures.
Creates a new procedural certification requirement for SBA loan personnel and mandates agency rulemaking.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator shall issue regulations implementing this Act

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent ongoing certification requirement for relevant loan employees beginning 270 days after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Beginning on the date that is 270 days after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Administrative costs or resource requirements for the SBA to implement and monitor the new certification process.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires Small Business Administration employees involved in loan origination, review, or approval to sign written conflict-of-interest certifications and mandates that the SBA issue implementing regulations.
